candidates.requirement: Exercise the parser's saved exponent state restoration by continuing a number through another parse_ex call on the same tokener.
candidates.target_route: For example, call parse_ex on [0e, then call it on -1] using the same tokener; the second call enters the saved-buffer branch and accepts the exponent minus.
candidates.failure_condition: The old entry creates a fresh tokener, makes exactly one parse_ex call, then frees it. No supplied input can make that call resume a number from an earlier call.
candidates.alternative_paths: Other numbers in the same input enter number state after resetting the print buffer; trailing bytes, defaults, and delimiters do not create a second parse_ex call. The complete entry has no helper or reuse route.
